description: Word pairs for Undercover (Who-Is-The-Spy). Civilians receive `civilian`, the undercover receives `undercover` (a semantically close but distinct word). Each word ships a bank of candidate clues at varying `reveal` levels (0=very vague .. 2=quite revealing); agents SELECT a clue with Jev rather than generating text.
